question.text: Which of the following is a PASSIVE fixed-income strategy?

explanation.text: The Logic: Bond index fund replication = mirror benchmark = passive. All others are active (duration bets, curve shape bets, credit bets). The Trap: Barbell is an active curvature play; students sometimes call it passive because it's 'just construction'. Cross-Exam Context: IV, XIII cover; XXI-B tests classification. Manager's Pro-Tip: 'Buy-and-Hold' is passive; immunization is semi-active (requires rebalance). Know the spectrum.
